The higher the rating, the louder your headphones will play.N/A dBImpedanceImpedance is a measure, in ohms, of the resistance of a speaker's voice coil to the current supplied by the amplifier. Generally, the higher the impedance, the more electrical energy is required to drive the headphones' tiny speakers. Because of the limited power available from a portable player, headphones for portable use should have a maximum impedance of 64 ohms. The lower the impedance, the more efficient the headphones.N/AWeightThe weight of the headphones, measured in ounces.0.38 ouncesCord LengthThe length of the headphone's cord measured in inches.N/AParts WarrantyThe manufacturer's warranty period for parts.1 YearLabor WarrantyThe manufacturer's warranty period for labor.1 YearOur in-depth product researchResearched by Crutchfield's Mark G.Features Overview: The Apple AirPods Pro 2 are individual in-ear buds designed to work with your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, or Mac, as well as most other Bluetooth-enabled devices, including Android phones and tablets. The true-wireless AirPods power on and connect automatically with your device when you open the lid of the included charging case. AirPods use internal sensors and motion accelerometers to detect when they're in your ears, or when you touch them to control playback, answer a call, or activate Siri. The AirPods Pro 2 come with the MagSafe Charging Case that has the capacity to charge the AirPods multiple times for long listening sessions. The AirPods Pro 2 are 1.226" in height, 0.925" wide, and 0.972" deep, and weigh 0.19 ounces each. Bluetooth 5.3: The Apple AirPods Pro 2 have Bluetooth 5.3 Wireless technology. They are compatible with iPhone and iPod touch (with the latest version of iOS), iPad (with the latest version of iPadOS), Apple Watch (with the latest version of watchOS), Mac (with the latest version of macOS), Apple TV (with the latest version of tvOS), and Apple Vision Pro (with the latest version of visionOS). They are also work with non-Apple Bluetooth devices, but functionality may be limited. Active Noise Cancellation: The new AirPods Pro 2 offer pro-level Active Noise Cancellation, up to 2x more than the AirPods 4 with ANC. It starts with a 10dB noise reduction due to the silicone ear tips (4 pairs are included) which creates an acoustic seal that keeps out sound. With the new H2 headphone chip and upgraded microphones, the AirPods Pro 2 actively reduces noise at 48,000 times per second. Sounds in the lower frequencies, such as the low rumble of highway traffic, HVAC systems, and airplane engines, are cancelled, so all you hear is your music. Related features include: Transparency Mode: When you want more awareness of your surroundings, Transparency Mode lets in more environmental sounds to keep you safe. Adaptive Audio: As your noise environment changes, Adaptive Audio makes adjustments to the level of ANC applied to the AirPods to give you the best sound quality. Conversation Awareness: When you are having a nearby conversation, the AirPods automatically lowers the volume of your music until you're finished. Hearing Health: The Apple AirPods Pro 2 provides a comprehensive hearing health experience with a scientifically-validated personalized hearing test that gives instant results to show you the degree of your hearing loss. The clinical-grade Hearing Aid feature of the AirPods Pro 2 immediately helps you to hear more clearly by boosting the frequencies where you have a hearing deficit. It also makes adjustments throughout the day to help you hear music, videos, and phone calls more clearly. AirPods Pro 2 also provides active Hearing Protection to prevent exposure to loud environments by attenuating persistent noise up to 110dB. These Hearing Health features require a free software update from Apple. Note: The Hearing Protection feature is less effective against extremely loud, sudden sounds, such as gunfire or fireworks, or continuous sounds over 110dBA. Power Requirements: Each individual Apple AirPod has a built-in rechargeable battery. The batteries are charged whenever you place them inside of the MagSafe Charging Case, which contains its own rechargeable battery. The AirPods Pro 2 are equipped with Apple's new H2 headphone chip, which makes them more stable and more efficient than models with the H1 chip. The AirPods Pro 2 provide up to 6 hours of listening (up to 5.5 hours with Spatial Audio and Head Tracking enabled), and up to 4.5 hours of talk time on a single charge. You can also listen to Lossles audio with Apple Vision Pro for up to 4 hours. A 5-minute Quick Charge in the case gives you up to 1 hour of listening time or 1 hour of talk time. You can check the charge status of your AirPods and Charging Case with a compatible Apple device (iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, or Mac). MagSafe Charging Case: Charging the AirPods is as simple as placing them in their new MagSafe Charging Case (USB-C). The case has enough stored power to charge the AirPods four additional times to give you a total of up to 30 hours of listening time and up to 24 hours of talk time. The LED indicator on the front of the case lets you know the AirPods are charging. The MagSafe Charging Case can be charged via the included USB-C cable and a USB charging adapter (not included). They can also charge wirelessly using a MagSafe charger, an Apple Watch charger, or other Qi-certified wireless charger. It also has a lanyard loop and built-in speaker to help you locate your AirPods with the Find My feature. If your iPhone has the U1 chip (iPhone 11 and later) like the MagSafe Charging Case, the Find My feature has Precision Finding to locate it exactly. The dimensions of the Charging Case are: Width 2.383", Height 1.78", Depth 0.858"; Weight 2.2 ounces with AirPods (1.8 oz. without). Water Resistant: The AirPods Pro 2 are dust, sweat, and water resistant for non-water sports and exercise. They have a rating of IP54. Apple H2 Headphone Chip: The AirPods Pro 2 are equipped with the Apple H2 headphone chip, the same one found in the AirPods 4. The H2 chip helps make your audio sound better for both music and phone calls. When the AirPods Pro 2 are paired with Apple Vision Pro, also equipped with the H2 chip, you can listen to Lossless Audio with ultra-low latency for an unprecedented sound experience. Personalized Volume: As you use your AirPods Pro 2s, they learn and understand your listening preferences in different environments, and automatically adapts the volume and sound based on those patterns. The Personalized Volume feature requires iOS 18, iPadOS 18, or macOS Sequoia or later, and the latest firmware in the AirPods. Voice Isolation: Another new feature of the H2 chip is Voice Isolation which minimizes background noise while clarifying the sound of your voice. Voice Isolation makes your voice stand out and easier to understand, especially in loud or windy conditions. Voice Isolation requires devices running iOS 18, iPadOS 18, or macOS Sequoia and later. Siri Interactions: The new H2 Headphone Chip enables Siri Interactions for a more personal, private, and convenient user experience. AirPod Pro 2 users can respond to Siri announcements with a simple head nod (up-and-down) for yes, or a head shake (side-to-side) for a no. This is helpful in areas where there are large noisy crowds or where you're not free to speak out loud. Siri Interactions allow you to answer or dismiss phone calls, interact with messages, and manage notifications without speaking. Microphones: The AirPods Pro 2 have built-in dual beam-forming microphones that focus on your voice, while rejecting ambient noise, making your phone calls crisp and clear. Adaptive EQ: The inward facing microphones hear what you're hearing. The Adaptive EQ automatically adjusts the low and midrange frequencies, so you're hearing the most detail in your music. Spatial Audio: When watching a supported show or movie, or listening to supported music on iPhone or iPad, you can enjoy Spatial Audio and Dynamic Head Tracking to create a unique immersive, theater-like experience. Spatial Audio surrounds you with sound that makes you feel like you're inside the scene or watching live on-stage. Built-in gyroscopes and accelerometers dynamically track the movement of your head to anchor the sound to your device. You can control Spatial Audio and Dynamic Head Tracking for each supported app in the Control Center of your iPhone or iPad. Sensors and Accelerometers: The AirPods Pro 2 feature built-in optical sensors and motion accelerometers that can automate numerous functions. When the AirPods are pulled out of their Charging Case, they instantly turn on and connect to your iOS device or compatible Bluetooth device. As soon as you put them in your ears, your music starts playing. Take one or both AirPods out and the built-in skin-detect sensors automatically pause the music you're listening to. Touch control sensors in the AirPods let you change volume with an up or down swipe, and control music playback and phone calls with one or two presses or holding the stem. The AirPods Pro 2 feature a separate voice accelerometer that can detect when you're talking on the phone or to Siri, and will engage the microphone and reject background noise so your call is crystal clear. Environmental Impact: AirPods Pro 2 are designed and manufactured with numerous features to reduce their environmental impact. They are made with 100% recycled rare earth elements in all their magnets, 100% recycled gold in the plating of multiple printed circuit board, and 100% recycled tin in the solder on multiple printed circuit boards. In addition, the packaging is 100% fiber-based. The battery charging system meets all requirements of the U.S. Department of Energy. Left and right true wireless AirPods Pro (2nd generation)(A3047/A3048)(white) Wireless Charging case (A2968) 4 Pairs of silicone ear tips (1 pair installed) 39" USB charging cable (USB-C on both ends) Quick Start Guide Safety and Handling booklet Warranty Summary booklet Regulatory Compliance Information booklet Ingestion Hazard warningAccessoriesAbout the Apple AirPods Pro 2by Crutchfield'sJeff Miller The second-generation AirPods Pro look almost identical to the originals, but they're loaded with more cutting-edge technology. Noise-canceling AirPods with the latest Apple technology There's a reason the AirPods remain as popular as ever — even with all the other true wireless earbud options out there. The beauty is how seamlessly they work with your iPhone and other Apple gear. The AirPods Pro 2 are fueled by Apple's latest processing chip, the H2, for their snappiest experience yet. The H2 chip has stronger processing and is more energy efficient than the already formidable H1 chip found in the first generation AirPods Pro. These earbuds offer more powerful noise cancellation along with Apple's clearest, most linear sound yet. Apple also revamped the drivers and dedicated amplifiers to help lower distortion and serve up more detail. Ear tips for a stable fit Unlike the "traditional" AirPods, Apple includes four sizes of ear tips here. I've tested a lot of in-ear headphones and I can't stress how much a proper fit can improve sound — and noise cancellation. These flexible, silicone tips will conform to the shape of your ear to create a comfortable, secure fit. Smart, real-time noise canceling technology These earbuds use an array of built-in mics to capture external sounds, then adjust the level of noise cancellation. Newer algorithms and the H2 chip's faster processing reduce latency a miniscule amount. So, noise is basically cancelled out as it happens. Easy pairing and controls with Apple gear like the iPhone (sold separately) Cleaner transition to Transparency mode When you need to be aware of your surroundings, simply press and hold either AirPod stem to activate "Transparency" mode. The built-in mics let in external sounds, so you can hear your surroundings. This time around, Apple's internal circuitry helps smooth out harsh and louder noises — like sirens and large engines — so they don't sound as overwhelming when you switch over. Steady, high-quality connection to your Apple gear While the AirPods will play music wirelessly from any Bluetooth-enabled phone or music source, the H2 chip makes pairing up with Apple devices even more special. A one-tap connection syncs up the earbuds to your iPhone®, and then you're automatically paired to other devices on your iCloud® account (like your Apple Watch®, iMac®, or iPad®). 3D sound for iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV These headphones also use head-tracking technology to serve up "spatial audio" for certain shows, movies, and music. It's designed to emulate the sound of a Dolby Atmos home theater speaker setup in a room. And as you nod or turn your head, the sound field stays fixed and centered. To make things even more immersive, Apple can tailor the spatial audio experience to your ears. The sound adjusts itself based on the shape and geometry of your ears and head. If you have an iPhone with a TrueDepth camera, you can snap a photo of the side of your head to create your personal profile. That profile will sync up and follow you to your iPad, iPhone, and Apple TV 4K. It's great for shows and movies, plus it adds an extra dimension to your tunes when listening to spatial audio music tracks on Apple Music. That streaming service has thousands of songs mixed in Dolby Atmos, and the Atmos version plays automatically when you're wearing AirPods. Apple added a lanyard loop to the side of the MagSafe wireless charging case. Clear phone calls and FaceTime conversations AirPods have become an everyday essential for some, often as much for phone calls or FaceTime as music listening. They make it so easy to hop on conference calls, order food, or talk when you're out and about. Apple added an inward-facing microphone that can better filter out external sounds for clear calls and FaceTime conversations in noisier environments. A carrying case that's compatible with wireless Apple Watch charging systems These AirPods offer six hours of music listening with noise cancellation on a full charge. When you need to refuel, just click the AirPods into their included wireless charging case. It can bank 24 hours of power to recharge your AirPods. The MagSafe charging case can be placed on a compatible Qi charger (not included) to refresh the charge wirelessly. An audible beep tells you it's working. It also has a built-in tracking chip that works with the "Find My" feature on iPhone. The case even has a built-in speaker that can play an audible tone to help you locate it.
